units.title: Families
units.intro: Family units of the school, with their guardians, students and links.
units.caption: Family units

empty.title: There are no family units yet
empty.text: Create the first family unit to add its guardians and students.

form.title: New family unit
form.description: Create a family unit. You can then add its guardians, its students and the links between them.
form.codeHint: Optional. If you leave it empty, the system assigns the next code.

form.title: Add guardian
form.description: Choose the user of the school who will be the guardian of this unit.
form.userIdHint: You do not have permission to search users: type their public identifier.

confirmRemove.title: Remove {name} from the unit
confirmRemove.description: Their links with the students of the unit will also be deactivated. This action is recorded in the audit log.

form.title: Add student
form.description: Add a student to the family unit by their person record.
form.person: Identifier of the student's person record
form.personHint: The student search does not exist yet: type the public identifier of their person record.

confirmRemove.title: Remove {name} from the unit
confirmRemove.description: The guardians' links with this student will also be deactivated. This action is recorded in the audit log.

links.title: Links
links.caption: Links between guardians and students
links.addNeeds: To create a link, the unit needs at least one guardian and one student.

form.title: New link
form.description: Link a guardian of the unit with a student of the unit.
form.legalHint: Marcar la representación legal registra que el centro la ha verificado.

confirmRevoke.title: Revoke {guardian}'s access to {student}
confirmRevoke.description: El tutor pierde el acceso a este alumno de inmediato. Motivo registrado: {reason}. El detalle de la resolución no se guarda aquí.

confirmLift.title: Lift the revocation of {guardian} over {student}
confirmLift.description: The guardian regains access to this student with the same permissions as before.

flash.guardianRemoved: {name} has been removed from the unit.
flash.studentRemoved: {name} has been removed from the unit.

consents.intro: Current image-consent status of each student, by level.

consents.unitCaption: Image consents of the students in the unit

consents.emptyUnit: The students in this unit have no consents to show.

history.title: Decision history of {name}

history.caption: Image decisions of {name}
history.empty: This student has no recorded decisions.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Versions of the terms of use and of the image-consent text of each level.

form.kindImmutable: The type cannot be changed once the version is created.

text.description: Text of the version, in your language or, if missing, in the centre's default language.

publish.requiresReacceptance: Require those who accepted a previous version to accept again
publish.requiresReacceptanceHint: If you leave it unchecked, only those who have never accepted will see the acceptance wall.
